text.p: Following are the main stories in Slovenia's Monday morning newspapers:
- The number of over-night stays by foreign tourists at the Slovenian seaside rose by 22 percent in the first half of 1997 compared to the same period last year.
- Prime Minister Janez Drnovsek was named the political personality of the month in an opinion poll.
- Slovenian athletes so far had no success at the Athletic World Championships in Athens.

- Some 23.5 percent of Slovenians would vote for the centre-left Liberal Democrats, followed by 12.8 percent of votes for the conservative People's Party if elections took place this week, an opinion poll said.
- According to a new law foreigners will only be able to apply for Slovenian citizenship after living in Slovenia continuously for eight years, up from three years previously.
- Slovenia's seventh soccer championship started on Sunday.
- Almost 194,000 of two million Slovenians are granted benefits for disabled people.
- A large number of tourists caused a lot of delays on Slovenian roads over the weekend.
